title: You Can Ask for a Chaperone
about: A notice to post in exam rooms and the waiting room: any patient may ask for a chaperone at any exam, at any time, without giving a reason. Record each offer on the Chaperone Record or in the visit note.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.text: You can ask for a chaperone for any exam or procedure. A chaperone is a trained member of our staff who stays in the room during your exam.
You can ask at any time, even after the exam has started. You do not have to give a reason. Just tell any member of our staff.
You can ask for a chaperone of a certain gender, and we will do our best to find one. If no chaperone is free, you can choose to wait or to come back on another day.
A family member or friend may stay with you too, but they do not take the place of a chaperone.
Your clinician may also ask for a chaperone to be in the room. If you do not want one, tell us and we will talk about your choices.
If anything during an exam makes you uncomfortable, you can ask to stop. Questions or concerns: call {facility.phone}.
